command: id; uname -a; for p in ro.product.model ro.product.device ro.board.platform ro.boot.hardware.sku ro.boot.slot_suffix ro.build.fingerprint ro.build.version.release ro.boot.bootloader; do echo "$p=$(getprop "$p")"; done; cat /sys/devices/soc0/{soc_id,machine,family,revision} 2>/dev/null

cat /proc/partitions; ls -l /dev/block/by-name; ls -l /sys/class/scsi_device; for d in /sys/class/block/sd*; do echo "=== $d"; cat "$d/device/vendor" "$d/device/model" "$d/device/rev" "$d/size" "$d/queue/logical_block_size" 2>/dev/null; done

for d in /sys/class/graphics/fb0 /sys/class/backlight/* /sys/class/leds/lcd-backlight; do echo "=== $d"; ls -l "$d"; for n in name panel_info modes virtual_size bits_per_pixel stride max_brightness brightness actual_brightness bl_power; do if [ -f "$d/$n" ]; then echo "--- $n"; cat "$d/$n"; fi; done; done; ls -l /sys/class/drm; ls /sys/kernel/debug /d 2>/dev/null

for d in /sys/class/power_supply/*; do echo "=== $d"; for n in type status health capacity voltage_now current_now temp charge_full_design charge_full charge_counter model_name manufacturer; do if [ -f "$d/$n" ]; then echo "$n=$(cat "$d/$n")"; fi; done; done; for d in /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/policy*; do echo "=== $d"; cat "$d/related_cpus" "$d/cpuinfo_max_freq" "$d/scaling_available_frequencies" 2>/dev/null; done
ls -l /sys/class/udc; getprop sys.usb.config; getprop sys.usb.state; cat /proc/mounts | sed -n "/firmware/p;/debugfs/p"

for n in clkgate_enable clkscale_enable rpm_lvl spm_lvl max_bus_bw; do echo "=== $n"; cat /sys/devices/platform/soc/1d84000.ufshc/$n; done; for d in /sys/devices/platform/soc/1d84000.ufshc/devfreq/*; do for n in governor available_frequencies cur_freq min_freq max_freq; do echo "=== $n"; cat "$d/$n" 2>/dev/null; done; done; for d in /sys/class/scsi_device/*; do echo "=== $d"; cat "$d/device/vendor" "$d/device/model" "$d/device/rev" "$d/device/type" 2>/dev/null; done; cat /sys/class/scsi_host/host0/active_mode; ls -l /sys/bus/platform/devices/1d84000.ufshc/iommu_group; ls -l /dev/block/by-name/boot_a /dev/block/by-name/boot_b /dev/block/by-name/super /dev/block/by-name/userdata

for d in /sys/class/regulator/regulator.*; do echo "=== $d"; for n in name microvolts state num_users min_microvolts max_microvolts type; do if [ -f "$d/$n" ]; then echo "$n=$(cat "$d/$n" 2>/dev/null)"; fi; done; done

for d in /sys/class/drm/card0-DSI-1; do for n in panelName panelSupplier panelId panelVer modes status enabled; do echo "=== $n"; cat "$d/$n"; done; done; for n in ic_ver vendor path; do echo "=== touch $n"; cat /sys/class/touchscreen/ilitek/$n; done; cat /sys/bus/spi/devices/spi2.0/modalias; ls -l /sys/bus/spi/devices/spi2.0/driver
